obras.synopsis_es: Desde pequeños, Ginger y Louie sabían que eran distintos. Dos jóvenes Queer que, al habitar distintos espacios, enfrentan prejuicios sociales que intentan limitar su forma de ser. Esta tensión los confronta con su proceso identitario y los lleva a cuestionar la necesidad de validación externa. obras.synopsis_en: Since they were little, Ginger and Louie knew they were different. Two young Queers who, living in different spaces, face social prejudices that try to limit their way of being. This tension confronts them with their identity process and leads them to question the need for external validation. Thus, they decide to use fashion and their bodies as a tool to express and build their identity as a process of constant fluidity, free and without labels.

Enmarcando estas historias en un contexto social y político más amplio, el documental subraya la urgencia de una ley de reparación para personas trans mayores sobrevivientes, amplificando voces que han resistido décadas de marginación.

Refracción.synopsis_en: Eloísa, a 20-year-old girl, is in two relationships at the same time. Maricones.synopsis_es: Desde pequeños, Ginger y Louie sabían que eran distintos. Dos jóvenes Queer que, al habitar distintos espacios, enfrentan prejuicios sociales que intentan limitar su forma de ser. Esta tensión los confronta con su proceso identitario y los lleva a cuestionar la necesidad de validación externa. Así, deciden usar la moda y sus cuerpos como herramienta para expresar y construir su identidad como un proceso de constante fluidez, libre y sin etiquetas.
Maricones.synopsis_en: Since they were little, Ginger and Louie knew they were different. Two young Queers who, living in different spaces, face social prejudices that try to limit their way of being. This tension confronts them with their identity process and leads them to question the need for external validation. Thus, they decide to use fashion and their bodies as a tool to express and build their identity as a process of constant fluidity, free and without labels.
